title: 新加坡拒为非法贸易渠道，总理黄循财说
titleEn: Singapore will not be illegal trade conduit: PM Wong
summary: 黄总理表示新加坡拒绝充当非法贸易渠道，同时讨论AI对劳动力的影响与全球贸易壁垒。
summaryEn: PM Wong said Singapore will not be used as a conduit for illegal trade, while addressing AI's impact on the workforce and rising global trade barriers.
speaker: Lawrence Wong
